prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already spoken with our client about this incident, please let us know so that we may address it.

We respectfully request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm receipt of this request in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, telematics or event data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please ensure that no materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this matter is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
